title: PFCP: Add dissection for Juniper IEs 32905, 32922, 32930, 32940
description:
- 32905 (CPRI Port Info): Parses priority-level port numbers
- 32922 (Port Network Instance Delete): Includes a delete flag field
- 32930 (COS Forwarding Class Info): Decodes forwarding class info length
and corresponding byte data
- 32940 (Hierarchical Schedule): Decodes implicit hierarchy flag and
maximum hierarchy levels

IEs 32930 and 32940 are grouped under BBF Logical Port Report IE 32796.
